findSearching: Looking for servers on your network…
findNone: No servers found on your network yet.
findNotSupported: This device can't search your network. Enter your server's address instead.
addressHint: It looks like 192.168.1.20 or https://media.example.com. WittyMediaServer shows it when it starts.
errScheme: That isn't a web address. Use something like 192.168.1.20.
errCredentials: Leave out the name and password. You'll sign in on the next screen.
errInvalid: That doesn't look like an address. It should look like 192.168.1.20.
errPublicHttp: That address is on the internet, and your password would travel unencrypted. Use an https:// address instead.
errUnreachable: Can't reach a server there. Check the address, and that WittyMediaServer is running and this device is on the same network.
errNotServer: Something answered at that address, but it isn't WittyMediaServer.
errLost: Lost contact with your server. Check that it is running, then try again.
errNotSetUp: That server hasn't been set up yet. Open its address in a web browser to finish setting it up.
errServerOld: That server is too old for this app. Update WittyMediaServer, then try again.
